points.description: Names dust particles (airborne dust / soil dust) as a nucleus material for ice crystals.
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely stated, e.g. 'particles' or 'soil' without dust.

points.description: Names clay minerals (clay) as a nucleus material.
points.partial_credit: Half if only a general mineral or soil is given instead of clay.

points.description: Names organic particles AND ordinary ocean (sea) salts as nuclei; each is half of this point's 0.66 marks.
points.partial_credit: Half if only one of organic material or ocean/sea salts is given.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) need all listed materials: dust particles, clay minerals, organic matter and ocean salts, in any wording with clear synonyms (e.g. sea salt, biological particles). Give part marks when some items are right or an item is vague; the number of correct items sets the mark. Wrong or unrelated materials earn nothing, but do not cancel correct items. Round the total to the nearest whole mark (0, 1 or 2) as the teacher does.
